input.placeholder: Ask about sea conditions, fishing zones, safety or routes…
input.micUnsupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser

chips.title: Try a question
items: Where is the nearest Potential Fishing Zone today?
Is it safe to go to sea tomorrow morning from Kanyakumari?
What are the tide, weather and sea conditions near my location?
Any cyclone or lightning alerts in my area?
What is the safest route from Chennai to Puducherry for a small fishing vessel?
Am I close to any restricted or international boundary water?
Why has fish productivity dropped near this coast?

scenarios.title: Demo scenarios
scenarios.hint: Each runs the real pipeline against live APIs, with a labelled cached snapshot as fallback.

trace.waiting: Ask a question and every agent's work appears here, live.
trace.noLlm: No API key — deterministic planner and template synthesis

risk.title: Risk assessment

bandNote.CAUTION: Sail only with caution and a working radio
bandNote.UNKNOWN: Not enough data to judge these conditions — this is not clearance to sail

risk.engineNote: Hazard classification is computed by a deterministic rule engine. No language model is involved in this decision.
risk.waiting: Run a query to compute a risk assessment.

alerts.title: Active alerts
alerts.none: No active warnings for the saved location.
alerts.channel: This is the message that would be delivered over SMS / IVR / push in production. No SMS provider is integrated in this prototype.

verdict.SAFE: Conditions look safe for a small fishing vessel.
verdict.UNSAFE: It is not safe to venture to sea.
verdict.UNKNOWN: There is not enough data to judge whether it is safe. Treat this as a no-go until the missing data is available.

ans.sea: Sea state: waves {wave} m, swell {swell} m, wave period {period} s, sea surface temperature {sst} °C.
ans.wind: Wind {wind} km/h gusting {gust} km/h from the {dir}. {weather}. Rainfall {precip} mm across the window.
ans.pfzFound: Nearest potential fishing zone is {km} km {dir} of {loc}, in the {depth} m depth band, with surface temperature {sst} °C and chlorophyll-a {chl} mg/m³.
ans.pfzNote: This zone is a demo derivation from sea surface temperature and a chlorophyll proxy. It is not an INCOIS advisory.
ans.pfzNone: No candidate fishing zone was found within range of this location.
ans.geoCritical: You are {nm} nautical miles from {name}. Turn back now — this is inside the critical buffer.
ans.geoWarning: You are {nm} nautical miles from {name}, inside the advisory buffer. Alter course away from the boundary.
ans.geoAdvisory: You are {nm} nautical miles from {name}. Stay aware of your position.
ans.geoClear: The nearest maritime boundary, {name}, is {nm} nautical miles away. You are well clear.
ans.geoAccuracy: Boundary positions in this prototype are approximate and must not be used for navigation.
ans.route: Passage from {from} to {to} is about {km} km over {n} scored waypoints. Worst condition on the route is {band}, mean risk score {mean} out of 100.
ans.routeClear: No waypoint on this route triggered a hazard rule.
ans.productivity: Productivity near {loc} is driven by the surface temperature and chlorophyll signal. Current surface temperature is {sst} °C and the nearest derived zone scores {score} out of 1. Warmer surface water suppresses the nutrient mixing that feeds the food chain, so catch falls when the thermal front weakens or moves offshore.
ans.productivityNote: A full explanation needs a chlorophyll and SST time series. This prototype ships a single static sample, so this is directional, not a diagnosis.
ans.harbour: Nearest harbour of refuge is {name}, {km} km away.
ans.engineNote: The safety verdict was computed by a deterministic rule engine, not by a language model.
ans.unknown: I could not identify what you are asking. ORCA can answer questions about fishing zones, sea and weather conditions, safety before sailing, cyclone and lightning alerts, safe routes between harbours, and proximity to restricted or international waters.
ans.inland: This position is {km} km inland from the coastline, so no marine forecast is available for it. The nearest coastal point with data is {name}.
ans.degraded: Some data was unavailable for this answer, so confidence is reduced. Missing: {list}.
ans.replay: This is a historical replay of {event}, not current conditions.

rules.wave-danger: Significant wave height exceeds the high-wave alert threshold
rules.wave-caution: Significant wave height in the small-craft advisory band
rules.swell-danger: Swell height in the surge alert band
rules.steep-sea: Short steep sea: wave period below the safe threshold with high waves
rules.wind-danger: Sustained wind at or above the IMD fishermen warning threshold
rules.wind-caution: Sustained wind in the small-craft advisory band
rules.precip-danger: Heavy rainfall accumulated across the window
rules.visibility: Visibility below the safe navigation threshold
